scripts.dev: concurrently -n popup,background "vite build --config vite.popup.config.ts --watch" "vite build --config vite.background.config.ts --watch"
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && rm -rf dist && concurrently -n popup,background "vite build --config vite.popup.config.ts" "vite build --config vite.background.config.ts"
scripts.screenshot: npm run build && npx playwright install chromium && node scripts/screenshot-popup.mjs
